context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 最短/溶接/果樹/各紙/三国/記念碑/海運/布教

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、最短期間で、絶対、解決、絶対、目指しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this case with absolute seriousness and working to resolve it in the shortest timeframe possible.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Slight formal weight on 'absolute seriousness.' Professional composure — speaking from prepared talking points but with genuine commitment underneath. Steady eye contact maintained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工場の溶接、本気で、絶対、不備で、絶対、火災が起きた、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The factory welding defect caused the fire, didn't it?
lines.style: Lean forward slightly. Genuinely asking — not accusatory, but wanting confirmation of what he's pieced together. Quiet intensity. A moment of pause before the question, like he's considered it carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。果樹農家の、本気で、絶対、被害、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively investigating the damage to the fruit farmers' property. The investigation is progressing.
lines.style: Professional, steady. Speak as if reading from notes but allow the weight of 'fruit farmers' damage' to land — this is real harm to real people. Measured pace. Brief pause after 'Yes' for gravity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、各紙、絶対、大きく、絶対、報じていますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The media has been covering this case quite extensively across all the papers.
lines.style: Quieter observation, almost to himself. Acknowledging the public attention — not defensive, but aware of the scope. Slight trailing-off, as if thinking through the implications. Thoughtful rather than hurried.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。三国合同の、本気で、絶対、捜査、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're conducting a joint investigation across three nations with our police partners, and we're moving forward steadily.
lines.style: Return to formal register. Measured emphasis on 'three nations' — conveying scope and coordination without pride. Professional cadence. Slight weight on 'moving forward' — reassurance of progress, not just procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、記念碑、絶対、破損も、絶対、捜査対象、絶対、ですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Is the regional monument damage also part of the investigation scope?
lines.style: Direct question, but genuinely curious — not pressing, seeking clarification. Slight tilt of head. Quiet voice, focused. The way someone asks when they've noticed something others haven't mentioned yet.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。海運関係者からも、本気で、絶対、情報、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've also been receiving information from people in the shipping industry, and that's been very helpful.
lines.style: Acknowledge the expanded scope. 'Shipping industry' gets a slight lift — this is an important lead. Steady, methodical. Brief pause before continuing, showing he's tracking multiple threads of investigation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 宗教の布教を、本気で、絶対、装った犯罪、絶対、最近、増えているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand that crimes disguised as religious outreach activities have been increasing lately.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost tentative — not accusatory, but naming something he's observed or read. Slight furrow. A careful tone, like he's raising something sensitive but necessary. Trailing-off at the end, inviting confirmation.
